home.title: Clean technology for a regenerative future

about.title: Built for Asia’s regenerative decade
about.subtitle: Asia Green Technology partners with enterprises, cities, and innovators to turn climate ambition into working systems.
about.body: From renewable infrastructure to intelligent resource platforms, we combine local insight with global engineering standards — so every deployment is practical, measurable, and ready to scale.

services.title: Solutions that compound impact
services.subtitle: Three focused capabilities — designed to work alone or as one stack.
services.item1_body: Solar, storage, and hybrid microgrids engineered for reliability in dense urban and remote environments.
services.item2_body: Digital twins and monitoring layers that cut waste across water, energy, and industrial operations.
services.item3_body: Strategy-to-execution support: roadmap design, vendor orchestration, and measurable rollout programs.

approach.title: How we work
approach.subtitle: A clear path from ambition to operating infrastructure.
approach.step1_body: Map constraints, assets, and impact targets with your teams on the ground.
approach.step2_body: Prototype the right architecture — technical, operational, and financial — before capital is locked.
approach.step3_body: Implement with local partners, verify performance, and leave systems that your teams can own.
